says: L17's browser check that each drawn letter of the long line sits where the input draws it failed once and passed on the next run of the same tree, so the check is flaky.
proof: At 4b868ea4b, two runs of next/apps/fabrika/e2e/fabsh.visual.test.ts in a row, headless Chromium, nothing changed between them: the first failed with off letters 172 to 242 of the 12-times long line (expected [] got 71 indexes), the second passed. The measure reads input.scrollLeft and the layer's rects in one evaluate; a guess, not proved: a layer that has not yet followed the input's scroll after the last key reads as off.
cost: A 3-hour full run can go red on fabsh with no product change, and a reader cannot tell a real drift of the span layer from the race.
